description: This PHP source file defines the Employee class, which extends the Person class, representing employee data in the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties for employee attributes, methods for data retrieval, validation, custom field handling, access control, and query generation relevant to employee records.

classes.name: Employee
classes.description: Represents an employee entity extending the Person class, encapsulating employee-related fields and behaviors such as data access, permission checks, and custom field management within the SuiteCRM context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Employee object, sets up custom fields, and initializes email address handling.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the formatted name of the employee for summary displays.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Fills in additional list view fields; calls fill_in_additional_detail_fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fetches and sets the name of the supervisor ('reports_to_name') for the employee.

methods.name: retrieve_employee_id
methods.description: Retrieves employee ID based on username.

methods.name: verify_data
methods.description: Performs data validation; currently always returns true.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares employee data for list view, including display of messenger type and employee status.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates SQL query for exporting employee data with proper ordering and filtering.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Overrides parent to exclude portal-only users from list queries.

methods.name: hasCustomFields
methods.description: Checks whether the employee has custom fields defined.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides save to restrict employee updates by non-admin users to their own record.

methods.name: hasSaveAccess
methods.description: Determines if the current user has permission to save the employee record.

methods.name: setIsAdmin
methods.description: Resets the is_admin flag if the current user is not an admin, preventing unauthorized admin changes.

methods.name: isUpdate
methods.description: Checks if the record is an existing record being updated.
